title: Viking Acquisition Corp I 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Viking Acquisition Corp. I, a Cayman Islands-incorporated SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing a Business Combination Agreement with NorthStar Earth and Space Inc. The transaction involves SPAC continuation to Canada, followed by an amalgamation under CBCA, with approximately 30 million New Viking common shares issued as closing consideration at a $300 million company valuation.
key_points: Viking Acquisition Corp. I entered into Business Combination Agreement with NorthStar Earth and Space Inc. on April 16, 2026
SPAC will continue from Cayman Islands to Canada prior to closing
Aggregate equity consideration: approximately 30,000,000 New Viking common shares at $300 million company valuation
Earnout provision: up to 10,000,000 additional shares upon meeting Revenue Run Rate targets in 2027-2028
NorthStar is a Canadian corporation operating in the Earth and space sector
Upon closing, Viking will change its name to 'NorthStar'
